title: Cad Play End To End
description: Fix explicitHost React casing in platform renderer; verify CAD play quad panes mount, surface bindings, and interactions work end-to-end.
summary: Fixed CAD play quad viewports not mounting: renderBoundComponent used lowercase `<explicitHost />` so React treated registered surface hosts as unknown HTML elements. Renamed to `ExplicitHost` (PascalCase) matching the existing `Host` fallback path. Added a regression test for registerSurfaceBinding + UiRenderer cad nodes. Verified in browser: 4 WebGL canvases, engagement REPL, no explicitHost DOM nodes; cad/renderer tests (50) and platform renderer tests (11) pass.
